recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆巨核細胞胞質豐富、帶細顆粒，但只有一個圓形不分葉的核（monolobated megakaryocyte），周圍為各階段顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞，符合 MDS del(5q) 的巨核細胞形態。
features: Central megakaryocyte of medium size with abundant finely granular basophilic-to-pink cytoplasm
Single round, eccentric, non-lobated nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Adjacent small cells overlapping the megakaryocyte border
Background granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes, myelocytes, bands) and basophilic erythroblasts
No increase in blasts evident in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows a megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a single round non-lobated nucleus. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytic precursors including promyelocytes, myelocytes and band forms, together with erythroid precursors. Blasts are not increased in this field. The monolobated megakaryocyte morphology is characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), which must be confirmed by karyotype or FISH.

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytic cells are smaller with scant deeply basophilic, often blebbed cytoplasm and fine chromatin, unlike this granular cell with a condensed single nucleus.
Micromegakaryocytes are much smaller (near promyelocyte size), whereas del(5q) megakaryocytes are normal to medium size with a round nucleus.
Plasma cells are smaller with a perinuclear hof and basophilic non-granular cytoplasm, and osteoblasts have a hof separated from the nucleus and occur in clusters.
Normal or reactive megakaryocytes of this size show multilobated nuclei.
